name: capture-readiness
goal: Capture rendered images and ready audio without waiting for unrelated background network activity; preserve failed-media and exact-source checks.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Continuous background requests must not block screenshots after fonts and images render. Broken images remain rejected. Audio assertions wait for the exact current source rather than sampling before metadata loads.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Real browser regression times out on networkidle despite the image being loaded; broken-image rejection passes. CI audio regression observed empty currentSrc. Red log: /tmp/harness-capture-readiness-red-20261017.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Wait for DOM readiness, fonts and decoded images instead of background network silence. Preserve nonzero dimensions and failed-image refusal. Poll the audio source before checking its exact served address.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Two unchanged readiness regressions and both real five-check browser suites pass. Desktop/tablet/mobile captures, audio playback, served bytes and wrong-build rejection all pass; original assertions retained.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
